title: Component Map
description: Produced at step 12; drives the step-16 swap loop. Status column is append-only per swap. Every component in ui-inventory must have exactly one row.

fusionMcpVersion.description: Pinned MCP version used for counterpart lookups (D-006).

rows.description: May be empty: an app with zero reusable components is legitimate.

fusionCounterpart.description: Required when classification=swap; per MCP lookup.

disposition.description: Required when classification=no-counterpart; default policy D-003 (wrap).

commit.description: One component per commit: the commit SHA that completed this row.
